page.overview:
Who is Kylo Ren?

Ben Solo was a Force-sensitive human male who turned to the dark side of the Force and became known as Kylo Ren, the "Jedi Killer" who rose to power as master of the Knights of Ren and Supreme Leader of the First Order during the New Republic Era. Though neither Jedi nor Sith, Ren was trained in the ways of both orders and embodied the conflict between the dark and the light side of the Force, making him dangerously unstable. Despite his actions as Ren, Solo's connection to the light—combined with the love of his parents and his connection to the scavenger Rey—helped the fallen Jedi to reject the dark side shortly before his death in 35 ABY.

A scion of the legendary Skywalker family, Solo was the son of General Han Solo and Princess Leia Organa, as well as the nephew of Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, and grandson of the Chosen One Anakin Skywalker. Born in 5 ABY, Solo possessed raw strength in the Force and was trained in the Jedi arts as Skywalker's Padawan from 15 ABY to 28 ABY. Having inherited his bloodline's potential with the Force, Solo surpassed the other apprentices of his Master who hoped to see him rise not only as the first in a new generation of Jedi Knights, but also as a future leader in the restored Jedi Order. Unbeknownst to Solo at the time, he shared a powerful bond with Rey, granddaughter of the Sith Lord Darth Sidious, with whom he formed a powerful dyad in the Force.

Following the revelation of his grandfather's identity as the Sith Lord Darth Vader, Solo became disillusioned with his family and the Jedi Order, both of which he renounced after the destruction of the Jedi Temple on Ossus. Adopting the persona of Kylo Ren, the former Jedi took control of the Knights of Ren by killing their leader and subsequently championed the First Order's cause of removing corruption and chaos in the galaxy. Though trained in the ways of the dark side by Supreme Leader Snoke, Ren was unaware that his new Master was an artificial Strand-Cast created by Sidious, the fallen Galactic Emperor and Dark Lord of the Sith who was secretly resurrected on the planet Exegol in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy.

Also known as: Kylo, Ben Solo.
